data.notes: July 2027 is still early in the announcement cycle, so confirmed Tokyo-area listings currently skew toward J-pop/arena shows and announced festival date holds rather than club calendars.

events.title: Fuji Rock Festival 2027
events.summary: Fuji Rock announced its 30th-anniversary 2027 edition for July 23–25; lineup details were not yet published on the confirmation source.

events.title: TOKYO IDOL FESTIVAL 2027
events.summary: An artist schedule page confirms TOKYO IDOL FESTIVAL 2027 for July 30–August 1 at the Aomi temporary parking area/HOT STAGE, listing Boccaccio, 321, Aoi Matsuyama and others.

events.title: SEKAI NO OWARI ARENA TOUR 2027 — K-Arena Yokohama
events.summary: SEKAI NO OWARI bring their Arena Tour 2027 to nearby Yokohama for three K-Arena dates on July 23, 24, and 25.

events.title: TRIANGLE 2027 — Kanto
events.summary: Fukuoka rock festival TRIANGLE makes its Kanto debut at LaLa arena TOKYO-BAY on July 31 and August 1, with both days listed on the official site.

events.title: HIMEHINA LIVE 2027 “BUDOKAN”
events.summary: Virtual artist duo HIMEHINA headline Nippon Budokan for a one-night solo concert, with the official page listing 16:30 doors and a planned 17:30 start.

events.title: natori Zepp TOUR 2027 — Tokyo
events.summary: natori’s nationwide Zepp tour closes its Tokyo run with two consecutive nights at Zepp DiverCity on July 1 and July 2, with both shows listed as 18:00 doors and 19:00 start.

events.title: Arche LIVE TOUR -2027- — Tokyo
events.summary: R&B singer-songwriter Arche plays the Tokyo date of LIVE TOUR -2027- at Shibuya WWW X, with the promoter listing 16:30 doors and 17:15 start.
